prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and company size. A global creative agency that’s excellent for brand and UX won’t be the best pick if you need hard performance-driven paid media or B2B SaaS SEO.

To help you quickly, here’s a practical approach plus a few well-regarded SF options by specialty:

What to consider when choosing
- Primary goal: brand/UX, lead generation, e‑commerce revenue, SEO, paid acquisition, social, or full-funnel growth?
- Industry experience: SaaS, e‑commerce, fintech, health care, etc.
- Budget and contract length: monthly retainer vs. project vs. performance-based.
- Team size and culture fit: boutique vs. mid-market vs. global agency.
- KPIs and reporting expectations.
- Case studies and references in your vertical.

Examples of reputable agencies with strong SF presence (for different needs)
- Brand & digital product / UX: R/GA, AKQA, Huge (good for large brands and product design-heavy work).
- Performance marketing / paid acquisition: Metric Theory, 3Q Digital (specialize in PPC, paid social, ROI-driven campaigns).
- Growth & B2B SaaS marketing: many specialized growth agencies operate in SF — you’ll want one with proven SaaS case studies.
(Note: agencies change quickly — I can verify current availability and fit for you.)

If you want, I can:
- Ask a few quick questions (budget, industry, primary goals) and then
- Shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies tailored to your needs with notes on why each is a fit, likely pricing band, and suggested interview questions.

Which would you prefer: a shortlist tailored to your project, or do you want general guidance on how to evaluate proposals?
